title: bridge single repayment at maturity
_comment: Hand-computed ground truth for the bridge structure. The bridge accrues simple interest ACT/365 from close to maturity and repays principal plus all accrued interest in one payment. Inputs are pinned test vectors, exempt from band validation. Expected values are already quantized at their storage or metric boundary with ROUND_HALF_UP.
arithmetic: step 1: maturity_date = add_months(close 2026-02-27, 3) = 2026-05-27, day of month 27 preserved, 2026-05-27 is Wednesday, a business day, roll forward leaves it unchanged.
step 2: simple interest period spans (close 2026-02-27, maturity 2026-05-27], days_between = 89, ACT/365 year fraction = 89/365.
step 3: interest = 12.0000 percent_annual / 100 = 0.12 x 50,000,000 cents x 89/365 = 1,463,013.698630136986301369863 cents, quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 1,463,014 cents.
step 4: total_repayment = principal 50,000,000 + interest 1,463,014 = 51,463,014 cents, exact integer sum, paid in one payment at maturity 2026-05-27.
step 5: closing_fee = 2.00 percent x 50,000,000 cents = 1,000,000 cents = 10,000.00 USD, exact product, no rounding needed.
step 6: moic = (interest 1,463,014 + principal 50,000,000 + warrant value 0) / 50,000,000 = 1.02926028, quantize to scale 2 with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 1.03, closing fee excluded from the numerator.
step 7: warrant_coverage_pct 0.00 means no warrant is granted, so warrant value publishes as 0 usd_minor_units with status not_granted, never a missing field.

all_in_rate.source: fixture pinned rate, not a Valet observation
